messages.subject: stoprule plan ready: 14 tasks, reflect partial (1 blocking finding)
messages.body: worker_status: succeeded; /sc:workflow wrote the plan .dev/tasks/to-do/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181616/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181616.md (14 tasks in 6 phases, every task with acceptance criteria, INSTALL.md is Task 13, brief templates are Task 14) applying the owner rulings (variant without the Unattended mode section, verbatim S1 briefs with only the name substitution and the --re-review/--baseline clause), and .dev/tasks is staged. The advisory reflect check ran at Tier 2 and ended partial: one blocking plan defect, C-003 (the Task 7 replay test cannot pass as written because no sentinel-bearing review-2 prior report is planned), plus 21 minor findings (task ordering in Tasks 3/5, the Usage line still advertising --unattended, the missing 'two claims on one prior counted once' test, and others) in .dev/brainstorms/346-stoprule/workflow-report/nested/reflect-1/REPORT.md; the plan was not edited from these findings. Not covered: progress.md is not created (the workflow skill leaves it to /sc:implement), the measurement copy built from the 472-line Arm B base is documented in INSTALL.md but not built by any task, and a subagent left a gitignored .venv in the worktree root.
